question: Of the schools that have won at least one Southeastern Conference Championship in football during the school years of 2000-2020 (per the official website of the SEC), which had 10 or more Rhodes Scholars from 1904 – 2023 (per the official website of the Rhodes Trust) and at least one Marshall Scholar in either (or both) of 2020 and 2021 (per the official website of the Marshall Scholarship)?
gold_answer: University of Alabama, University of Florida

**SEC‑football champions (2000‑2020)** — Alabama, Florida, Georgia, LSU, Auburn  
**Rhodes‑Scholar counts (1904‑2023)** — Alabama 17, Georgia 27, Florida 13, LSU 14 (> 10; Auburn 5 < 10)  
**Marshall‑Scholar presence (2020 or 2021)** — Alabama 5 (2020 + 5 (2021)), Georgia 5 + 5, Florida 3 + 3; LSU 0 (LSU not listed in the 2021 competition statistical report).

| School | SEC Championship(s) 2000‑2020 | Rhodes‑Scholars (≥ 10) | Marshall Scholars (2020 or 2021) | Meets all three criteria? |
|--------|------------------------------|------------------------|----------------------------------|---------------------------|
| **University of Alabama** | Champions in 2012, 2014‑2016, 2018‑2020 (7 titles) | 17 (≥ 10) | 5 (2020) + 5 (2021) | **Yes** |
| **University of Florida** | Champions in 2000, 2006, 2008 (3 titles) | 13 (≥ 10) | 3 (2020) + 3 (2021) | **Yes** |
| **University of Georgia** | Champions in 2002, 2005, 2017 (3 titles) | 27 (≥ 10) | 5 (2020) + 5 (2021) | **Yes** |
| **Louisiana State University** | Champions in 2001, 2003, 2007, 2019 (4 titles) | 14 (≥ 10) | 0 (LSU does NOT appear in the 2021 report) | No |
| **Auburn University** | Champions in 2004, 2010, 2013 (3 titles) | 5 (< 10) | 0 | No |

**Answer:** The schools that satisfy all three conditions are **Alabama, Florida, and Georgia**.
